outcome: Compliance with quality standard for antibiotic administration (type, timing, single dose)
finding: Compliance with a quality standard for administering prophylactic antibiotics before cesarean section was high (90.9%) and improved over time, with better adherence during elective procedures and morning shifts.
mod_finding: This study found that compliance with guidelines for administering prophylactic antibiotics before cesarean section was higher for elective cesarean sections compared to emergency cesarean sections.
